# Segment 1 (0-8.6s) - Intro to trigonometry
title = Text("Trigonometry", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Relationships in Triangles", font_size=36).next_to(title, DOWN)

triangle1 = Polygon([-2,-1,0], [1,-1,0], [-0.5,1,0], color=BLUE)
triangle2 = Polygon([0,-1,0], [3,-1,0], [1.5,1,0], color=GREEN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(triangle1), Create(triangle2), run_time=2.6)
self.wait(2)

# Segment 2 (8.6-14.2s) - Focus on right triangle
self.play(
    FadeOut(triangle1), 
    FadeOut(triangle2),
    FadeOut(subtitle),
    title.animate.shift(UP),
    run_time=2
)

right_triangle = Polygon(
    [-1,-1,0], [1,-1,0], [-1,1,0],
    color=YELLOW
)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).move_to([-1,-1,0]).shift(RIGHT*0.15 + UP*0.15)

self.play(Create(right_triangle), Create(right_angle), run_time=2)
self.wait(1.6)

# Segment 3 (14.2-24.9s) - Identifying parts
angle = Arc(
    radius=0.5,
    start_angle=-PI/2,
    angle=PI/4,
    arc_center=[-1,-1,0],
    color=RED
)
theta = MathTex(r"\theta").next_to(angle, RIGHT).shift(LEFT*0.3 + UP*0.1)

self.play(
    Create(angle),
    Write(theta),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(7.7)

# Segment 4 (24.9-44.2s) - Labeling sides
hyp_label = Text("Hypotenuse", font_size=24).next_to(right_triangle, UR)
opp_label = Text("Opposite", font_size=24).next_to(right_triangle, LEFT)
adj_label = Text("Adjacent", font_size=24).next_to(right_triangle, DOWN)

hyp_line = Line([-1,-1,0], [-1,1,0], color=BLUE)
opp_line = Line([-1,1,0], [-1,-1,0], color=GREEN)
adj_line = Line([-1,-1,0], [1,-1,0], color=RED)

self.play(
    Create(hyp_line),
    Write(hyp_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Create(opp_line),
    Write(opp_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.play(
    Create(adj_line),
    Write(adj_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(10.3)

# Segment 5 (44.2-79.7s) - Trig ratios
ratios_title = Text("Trigonometric Ratios", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
sine_def = MathTex(r"\sin \theta = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}")
sine_def.next_to(right_triangle, RIGHT).shift(RIGHT*2)

self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(title, ratios_title),
    run_time=2
)

ratio_list = VGroup(
    Text("1. Sine (sin)", font_size=24),
    Text("2. Cosine (cos)", font_size=24),
    Text("3. Tangent (tan)", font_size=24),
    Text("4. Cosecant (csc)", font_size=24),
    Text("5. Secant (sec)", font_size=24),
    Text("6. Cotangent (cot)", font_size=24)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).next_to(ratios_title, DOWN).shift(LEFT*3)

self.play(Write(ratio_list), run_time=6)
self.play(Write(sine_def), run_time=3)
self.wait(24.5)

# Segment 1 (0-11.7s) - Intro to reciprocal trig identities
title = Text("Reciprocal Trigonometric Identities", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("The inverse relationships between trig ratios", 
               font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.7)

# Segment 2 (11.7-21.3s) - Highlighting importance
importance_box = VGroup(
    Text("Simplifies trigonometric problems", font_size=28),
    Text("Easy to understand and apply", font_size=28),
    Text("Fundamental relationships", font_size=28)
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(FadeOut(subtitle), run_time=1)
self.play(Create(importance_box), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.7)

# Segment 3 (21.3-38.1s) - Cosecant identity
csc_formula = MathTex(r"\csc A = \frac{1}{\sin A}").scale(1.5)
csc_box = SurroundingRectangle(csc_formula, color=BLUE)

self.play(FadeOut(importance_box), run_time=1)
self.play(Write(csc_formula), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(csc_box), run_time=1)
self.play(
    csc_box.animate.set_color(YELLOW),
    rate_func=there_and_back,
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(10.8)

# Segment 4 (38.1-56.9s) - Secant and cotangent identities
sec_formula = MathTex(r"\sec A = \frac{1}{\cos A}").scale(1.5)
cot_formula = MathTex(r"\cot A = \frac{1}{\tan A}").scale(1.5)

formulas = VGroup(csc_formula, sec_formula, cot_formula).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(csc_formula, formulas[0]),
    FadeOut(csc_box),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(sec_formula), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(cot_formula), run_time=2)
self.wait(12.8)

# Segment 5 (56.9-79.7s) - Summary and utility
summary_box = VGroup(
    Text("Key Benefits:", font_size=36),
    Text("• Express any ratio in terms of its reciprocal", font_size=28),
    Text("• Simplify trigonometric expressions", font_size=28),
    Text("• Solve trigonometric equations", font_size=28)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3).to_edge(LEFT)

self.play(
    formulas.animate.scale(0.7).to_edge(RIGHT),
    run_time=2
)
self.play(Write(summary_box), run_time=3)

highlight_box = SurroundingRectangle(summary_box, color=YELLOW, buff=0.2)
self.play(Create(highlight_box), run_time=2)
self.play(
    highlight_box.animate.set_color(BLUE),
    rate_func=there_and_back,
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(13.9)

section_title: Calculating All Ratios from One Given Ratio
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-10.2s) - Introduction
title = Text("Finding All Trig Ratios from One Ratio", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Starting with tan(A) = 4/3", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(6.2)

# Segment 2 (10.2-23.9s) - Given tangent ratio
given = MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{4}{3}").scale(1.5)
self.play(Write(given), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)
goal = VGroup(
    Text("Find:", font_size=32),
    MathTex(r"\sin A, \cos A, \csc A, \sec A, \cot A")
).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5).next_to(given, DOWN, buff=1)
self.play(Write(goal), run_time=3)
self.wait(6.7)

# Segment 3 (23.9-38.6s) - Drawing right triangle
self.play(FadeOut(given, goal), run_time=1)
triangle = Polygon(
    ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, UP*4,
    color=WHITE, fill_opacity=0.2
)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0], UR, buff=0)
labels = VGroup(
    MathTex("3").next_to(triangle.get_bottom(), DOWN),
    MathTex("4").next_to(triangle.get_left(), LEFT),
    Text("A", font_size=24).next_to(triangle.get_vertices()[0], DL, buff=0.1)
)
self.play(Create(triangle), Create(right_angle), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(labels), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 4 (38.6-56.9s) - Labeling sides
side_labels = VGroup(
    Text("Adjacent = 3", font_size=28),
    Text("Opposite = 4", font_size=28)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).to_edge(RIGHT)
self.play(Write(side_labels), run_time=3)
self.wait(15.3)

# Segment 5 (56.9-87.8s) - Pythagorean theorem
pythag = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"c^2 = a^2 + b^2"),
    MathTex(r"c^2 = 4^2 + 3^2"),
    MathTex(r"c^2 = 16 + 9"),
    MathTex(r"c^2 = 25"),
    MathTex(r"c = 5")
).arrange(DOWN).to_edge(LEFT)
self.play(Write(pythag[0]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(pythag[1]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(pythag[2]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(pythag[3]), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(pythag[4]), run_time=2)
hyp_label = MathTex("5").next_to(triangle.get_right(), UR)
self.play(Write(hyp_label), run_time=2)
self.wait(19)

# Segment 6 (87.8-101.0s) - Sine ratio
sine = MathTex(r"\sin A = \frac{4}{5}").scale(1.2).to_edge(RIGHT)
self.play(FadeOut(pythag, side_labels), run_time=1)
self.play(Write(sine), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.2)

# Segment 7 (101.0-113.7s) - Cosine and cosecant
cosine = MathTex(r"\cos A = \frac{3}{5}").next_to(sine, DOWN)
cosec = MathTex(r"\csc A = \frac{5}{4}").next_to(cosine, DOWN)
self.play(Write(cosine), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(cosec), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 8 (113.7-125.4s) - Secant and cotangent
secant = MathTex(r"\sec A = \frac{5}{3}").next_to(cosec, DOWN)
cotangent = MathTex(r"\cot A = \frac{3}{4}").next_to(secant, DOWN)
self.play(Write(secant), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(cotangent), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.7)

# Segment 9 (125.4-139.1s) - Conclusion
conclusion = Text("All ratios found using Pythagorean theorem\nand one given ratio!", 
                 font_size=32).to_edge(DOWN)
self.play(Write(conclusion), run_time=3)
self.wait(10.7)

# Segment 1 (0-18.8s) - Introduction
title = Text("Proving Angle Equality Using Trigonometric Ratios", font_size=36).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = MathTex(r"\text{If }\sin B = \sin Q\text{, then }B = Q").next_to(title, DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(subtitle), run_time=3)
self.wait(12.8)

# Segment 2 (18.8-40.1s) - Drawing triangles
# First triangle
triangle1_points = [
    np.array([-3, -2, 0]),  # A
    np.array([-3, 0, 0]),   # B 
    np.array([-1, -2, 0])   # C
]
triangle1 = Polygon(*triangle1_points, color=BLUE)
angle_b = Arc(radius=0.3, start_angle=0, angle=PI/3, 
              arc_center=triangle1_points[0], color=YELLOW)
angle_b_label = MathTex("B").next_to(angle_b, RIGHT)
right_angle1 = Square(side_length=0.2).move_to(triangle1_points[2])

# Second triangle
triangle2_points = [
    np.array([1, -2, 0]),   # P
    np.array([1, 0, 0]),    # Q
    np.array([3, -2, 0])    # R
]
triangle2 = Polygon(*triangle2_points, color=RED)
angle_q = Arc(radius=0.3, start_angle=0, angle=PI/3,
              arc_center=triangle2_points[0], color=YELLOW)
angle_q_label = MathTex("Q").next_to(angle_q, RIGHT)
right_angle2 = Square(side_length=0.2).move_to(triangle2_points[2])

self.play(
    Create(triangle1),
    Create(triangle2),
    run_time=5
)
self.play(
    Create(angle_b), Write(angle_b_label),
    Create(angle_q), Write(angle_q_label),
    Create(right_angle1), Create(right_angle2),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(12.3)

# Segment 3 (40.1-66.5s) - Showing ratios
ratio_eq = MathTex(
    r"\frac{AC}{AB} = \frac{PR}{PQ}",
    r"\implies \frac{AC}{PR} = \frac{AB}{PQ} = k"
).next_to(subtitle, DOWN, buff=1)

self.play(Write(ratio_eq[0]), run_time=4)
self.wait(11)
self.play(Write(ratio_eq[1]), run_time=4)
self.wait(7.4)

# Segment 4 (66.5-94.4s) - Pythagorean theorem
pythag = MathTex(
    r"BC = k\sqrt{PQ^2 - PR^2}",
    r"\\QR = \sqrt{PQ^2 - PR^2}"
).next_to(ratio_eq, DOWN)

self.play(Write(pythag[0]), run_time=5)
self.wait(11)
self.play(Write(pythag[1]), run_time=5)
self.wait(6.9)

# Segment 5 (94.4-132.5s) - Final proof
final_ratio = MathTex(
    r"\frac{BC}{QR} = k",
    r"\implies \triangle ABC \sim \triangle PQR",
    r"\therefore B = Q"
).next_to(pythag, DOWN)

self.play(Write(final_ratio[0]), run_time=5)
self.wait(12)
self.play(Write(final_ratio[1]), run_time=5)
self.wait(11)
self.play(
    Write(final_ratio[2]),
    Circumscribe(angle_b, color=GREEN),
    Circumscribe(angle_q, color=GREEN),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(2.1)
